_doc: Claim-safety CONTROL + provenance record for the Shorts ambient bed library (assets/beds/, media gitignored). A bed is admissible ONLY if listed here with origin 'elevenlabs_generated' AND its bytes hash to the recorded sha256 (ytagent/assembly/beds.py enforces this). check_source_clean measures HISS, not ORIGIN — this manifest is what makes the beds claim-safe (own/generated, no Content ID even as a VOD). To add a bed: generate it via ElevenLabs Music, confirm check_source_clean PASSES, add an entry with its sha256 — a reviewed, committed act. A sourced/licensed track dropped into assets/beds/ has no matching attested entry and is structurally refused.
